name: Joint Institute for Nuclear Research (JINR), Dubna
notes: Several member states have suspended participation or the collaboration with Russian institutes is suspended in some projects (e.g. FAIR, PANDA); not modelled.
Only the NICA complex and its experiments are in this stream; JINR's other laboratories and external projects (NA61/SHINE, STAR, AMBER participation) are not recorded as JINR experiments.

operator_text.value: Joint Institute for Nuclear Research, an international intergovernmental scientific research organisation

summary.plain: An international intergovernmental research organisation in Dubna, Russia, founded in 1956. Its Veksler and Baldin Laboratory of High Energy Physics runs the superconducting Nuclotron and is commissioning the NICA collider for heavy-ion and spin physics.
summary.technical: JINR: intergovernmental organisation founded by eleven states on 26 March 1956; the VBLHEP accelerator complex comprises the Nuclotron (1993), the Booster and the NICA collider (Run 1 from 25 March 2025) serving the BM@N fixed-target experiment, the MPD detector and the planned SPD.
